existingReportSummary.executiveSummaryMd: EvidenceVariable has high-impact local breaking changes. The top migration concerns are: the required R4 `characteristic` backbone is removed; the primitive required-bound `type` code is replaced by a CodeableConcept-based `handling` model; and several optional R4 metadata/relationship fields are removed or reshaped. The main uncertainty is the absence of an authoritative R4-to-R6 ConceptMap or official migration narrative for the redesigned variable model.
existingReportSummary.migrationThemesMd: Migration is primarily a semantic remodeling exercise, not a field-by-field copy. R4 data centered on `characteristic.definition[x]`, optional exclusion/timing/aggregation fields, and a required `status`. R6 separates variable meaning, modifiers, handling, category, data storage, constraints, timing, and missing-data handling. R4-to-R6 transforms should therefore be rule-driven and reviewed by domain experts, especially when old instances use `definitionDataRequirement`, `definitionTriggerDefinition`, `definitionCanonical`, `exclude`, `groupMeasure`, or `relatedArtifact`.
existingReportSummary.confidenceSummaryMd: Confidence is high for element presence, cardinality, type, local flag, and invariant findings because they are directly observable in the two StructureDefinitions. Confidence is medium for exact terminology and semantic migration impact because full terminology expansions, official diffs, and authoritative ConceptMaps were not available.

rationaleMd:
EvidenceVariable keeps its resource identity. The aggregate has 3 hard R4-to-R6 instance break(s), 0 potential hard break(s), 2 non-mechanical migration finding(s), and 1 direct behavior/API finding(s).

R4 maturity context is trial-use/FMM 0, which creates weak stability pressure.

The computed migration-unavoidability score is 38/100, producing migration shape `moderate-targeted-remodel`, major migration `Partial`, and compatibility posture `preserve-where-low-cost-but-expect-resource-migration`.

recommendedStandardsPostureMd: Expect targeted migration work, but continue reviewing individual breaks. Use less-breaking designs where they do not preserve obsolete or conflicting models indefinitely.

topFindings.title: Several optional R4 metadata and relationship fields were removed or reshaped
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: old-valid/new-invalid: R4 instances using any removed field have undefined R6 elements. There is also metadata/tooling impact for catalog, search, and citation workflows that used jurisdiction, topic, subtitle, or RelatedArtifact.

topFindings.title: Required R4 characteristic backbone was removed and replaced by a new variable model
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: old-valid/new-invalid: an R4 instance containing the required `characteristic` element has an element not defined in R6; R6-to-R4 loss is also possible because new R6 variable-detail fields do not collapse cleanly into one R4 characteristic.
topFindings.whyRelevant: Owned by this resource's StructureDefinition report.

topFindings.title: R4 type code was removed and replaced by R6 handling CodeableConcept
topFindings.compatibilityMechanism: old-valid/new-invalid and runtime/API/codegen: populated R4 `type` is not an R6 element, and generated code changes from primitive required-bound code to CodeableConcept. R6-to-R4 conversion can be lossy for new handling codes or multi-coding concepts.
